policy.official_method: Press Ranger web app + optional MCP (https://pressranger.com/mcp). MCP can draft companies/releases; publishing and journalist email stay in the Press Ranger UI. No private UI scrape. Press Ranger does not offer a public bulk-send journalist API.

companies.do_not_paste_into_pr: gift cards, SMC, supplier names, fake stats
hosting as if it were this SKU, gift cards
invented SLA, datacenter tours, Social marketing SKUs

campaigns_ranked.headline_draft: BrandDad Directory puts WhatsApp next to the local listing — claim and message without a fake featured award
campaigns_ranked.why_first: Clearest product difference journalists can verify on the live homepage (WhatsApp-first, Select vs Featured).
campaigns_ranked.pitch_notes: Do not claim listing volume. Do not mention gift cards. Point to /select/methodology/ if they ask how Select works.

campaigns_ranked.headline_draft: BrandDad Social sells LinkedIn visibility and site checks — built around professional visibility and not invented traffic
campaigns_ranked.why_first: Service SKUs are public with prices; Check your website is a free door.
campaigns_ranked.pitch_notes: Do not quote subscriber counts. LinkedIn product is visibility, not outreach.

campaigns_ranked.headline_draft: BrandDad.co is a logo-and-website shop with Get started — not a walk-in storefront
campaigns_ranked.why_first: Simple commerce story; schema already Organization-only.
campaigns_ranked.pitch_notes: No invented customer counts. Footer holds sister sites; header stays logos/websites/get-started.

campaigns_ranked.headline_draft: HostTech lists four monthly hosting plans in a public shop — no invented unlimited SLA
campaigns_ranked.why_first: Prices are on /shopping/ and product pages; Contact has real support doors.
campaigns_ranked.pitch_notes: Quote only prices visible on live product pages. No datacenter address unless it appears on Contact.
